description: Create a thread (several posts, in order) and optionally schedule it. Same as create_post with thread; kept for older setups.

channel_ids.description: Channel ids to publish to (from list_channels).

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 time to publish, e.g. 2026-09-12T09:00:00Z. Omit for a draft.

tweets.description: The tweets, in order. First is the lead tweet.

name: schedule_thread
